nodes.label: Wallpaper Rotation Mechanism (concept: once-per-day auto rotate background per category)
nodes.rationale: No new extension permissions (no `alarms`, no background/service-worker). Rotation is opportunistically evaluated on new-tab open as a cheap date-string comparison, trading real-time rotation for zero added permission surface and zero background process — mirrors Bing/Edge daily wallpaper UX without their infrastructure.

nodes.label: Rooza (rooza.space) reference extension build
nodes.rationale: Rozaneh Tab/Rozaneh is explicitly built feature-for-feature parity with Rooza but under original branding and minimal-permissions constraints; local checkout at /home/mohsenghq/Documents/rooza-extension/rooza is used as ground truth for UI/markup/data when the agent is unsure how to build or style something.
